simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: אַלּוֹן בָּכוּת (ʼAllôwn Bâkûwth) means Allon-Bakuth , a monumental tree First listed occurrence: Gen 35 8.

definitions.full: H439. Allon Bakuth בָּכוּת noun feminine weeping . Only in בָּכוּת אַלּוֺן Gen 35:8 i.e. mourning oak , compare אלון , p. 47.
definitions.rootNote: from 437 and a variation of 1068 ; oak of weeping;
